name: vulnledger
description: VulnLedger — self-hostable vulnerability findings management platform

scripts.build: pnpm --filter api build && pnpm --filter web build
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter api lint && pnpm --filter web lint
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter api typecheck && pnpm --filter web typecheck && pnpm --filter contracts typecheck
scripts.postinstall: pnpm --filter api install && pnpm --filter web install && pnpm --filter contracts install
